explanation: Her creator, the psychologist William Moulton Marston, had worked on a blood-pressure test for lying that fed into the polygraph. She first appeared in 1941.

claims.text: Wonder Woman carries the Lasso of Truth, which compels those it binds to tell the truth.
Supergirl, Catwoman and Black Widow do not carry the Lasso of Truth.
Wonder Woman was created by William Moulton Marston, a psychologist.
Marston developed a systolic blood-pressure test for deception that was a forerunner of the polygraph.
